characterization_methods: Solid state H nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR)
evidence: The ﬁlm resistivity was calculated from the sheet resistance measured by the four-point probe method, and the ﬁlm thickness was measured with a ﬁeld emission scanning electron microscope (FESEM, JEOL JSM-840A). The ﬁlm crystallinity was examined using XRD (MAC Scientiﬁc Co. M18XHF), and chemical composition and phase composition in the deposited ﬁlm were measured by XPS (VG Scientiﬁc ESCALAB 220iXL). Solid state H NMR (Bruker, DSX 400MHz) and FTIR (Nicolet, 6700) were used to analyze the hydrogen content in the ﬁlms. AES (ULVACPHI INC., PHI 700) surface mapping of Ta, O, C, and N was done to investigate the phase distribution.
